nom: Curology Face Moisturizer for Dry Skin

avis.texte: 5 Star quality, but one star quantity value, maybe . See the photos on quantity. After 12 days I ordered another container of Curology Cream Moisturizer, 1.7 oz. The photos of the uncapped bottle in this review show the amount left at 17 days. At that point I am using a cosmetics spatula to get the cream out. I liked the pump until I had to store the container upside down in order to get any cream out. At 17 days that no longer worked, and I had to pop the cap off with a butter knife. It was simple enough, and it came off easily. After that it was easy to pop the cap on and off, in order to use a spatula to remove the cream. (It's just more sanitary with a cosmetic spatula.) Why do all this? Because it's really,really a top quality cream. This has the same ingredients as a department store cream selling for $400 A bottle. Honestly, I did over use it initially. For $17 it might be worth purchasing two at $34 a month. I mean it really is a spectacular cream. It deep down moisturizes skin. It's a choice. It's A quantity vs quality decision the consumer needs to make. The point of this review is to help you as a consumer make that decision fully aware.

The best moisturizer. I only buy this product now for daily moisturizer. This is a thicker moisturizer, but promotes hydration in the skin and absorbs well. I use it in the AM and PM after washing my face and one container lasts about 2 months. I have really sensitive skin and easily breakout, however this moisturizer works well for me and does not cause irritation or break out.

Good formula, doesn't cause me any problems. However, as others have said, the pump sucks. The product gets stuck in the pump, and sometimes it just doesn't even work...and if that happens, there's no way to fix it. I wish the packaging was better cause the formula is the best I have used (no pilling, great absorbency, doesn't cause any irritation or breakouts even on sensitive skin). If you don't mind the packaging being a bit frustrating, definitely give it a try.
My daughter and I both use this and the face wash. Great moisturizer. Not too heavy. No breakouts. Buy it on repeat!
So soft very hydrating on face no smell not heavy on skin will be ordering again
Nice lightweight moisturizer. It is not greasy and rubs in nicely. My t-zone is the opposite of most people’s and is dry. This helps moisturize the area all day. No scent.
Love this moisturizer. The only reason for 4 star is because the product wouldn't come out of the dispenser.
Have a nice scent also lightweight and the softness it’s doesn’t irritate my skin

Curology is a great line. They really have helped with keeping my acne at bay. This is a good gentle moisturizer for sensitive skin. I have super dry skin so its not quite as moisturizing as I'd like and doesn't leave my skin looking dewy which is a disappointment for me personally but otherwise its pretty good.

Loved this moisturizer, as a guy I'm not too into skin care, but feels very high quality, and my partner loves it as-well. Love the packaging, and the pump on the top. Perfect for traveling, and very lightweight. Amazing price, would recommend and buy again. Ps. Mind the loss of paint on the container.
Second time the pump stop working, and it’s not easy to get off and get to the product. I love the moisturizer when I’m able to use it but the pump alone will stop me from buying this.

I’d never heard of Curology before finding them in Amazon’s skin care offerings. This cream moisturizer is perfect for my face. It’s light and airy and weightless enough that I feel like I’ve somehow moisturized without adding anything to my freshly-washed face. It comes in an airless pump jar, which is the most sanitary and life preserving of dispensers and just downright clever. The dark blue bottle/jar with the white text looks classy, lush, and gender-neutrally inviting to use. I will happily order this moisturizer again, and I look forward to being impressed by other Curology products.

avis.titre: Moisturizer is great but fix the pump!
avis.texte: I love this product because it's non-comodogenic and gives my face the right amount of hydration. However, I just accidentally found out that once the pump stops working it does NOT mean that it's empty!! I've bought so many of these and once it gets to a point where I pump it like 10-20 times and nothing comes out, I assume that it's empty and throw it away. Yesterday I was doing the same and it accidentally fell and the top broke open and guess what?? More than half the bottle was still full!!! They really need to fix the pump because it only pumps out half the product. It would be a real shame if they already know this and use it as a tactice to get people to buy more. Please fix the pump so we can get all of the product inside!
The moisturizer is rich and hydrating but the letters always come off the bottle and get everywhere

avis.titre: Good product, awful and wasteful pump design
avis.texte: After about two weeks of using this product, the pump was no longer providing any of the moisturizer. When used I had read that the design was poor and that there was a lot left in there after it would stop pumping so I went ahead and took it apart. You can see in my photos. There is a significant amount of product left, but I had to take it apart to get to it and use the back end of a spoon to dig it out. I do think I have seen a difference in my skin since using the product and I’d like to keep using. Unfortunately the pump design for dispensing the moisturizer would make me look into other options.
I have no complaints about the product itself, but they need to fix this packaging. The white lettering comes right off and it’ll get on my hands as I’m trying to apply the product to my face…

avis.titre: Best moisturizer ever. Worst packaging ever.
avis.texte: Best moisturizer ever. The only one that works for me skin. But WORST packaging EVER. I have received so many broken ones. Curology I am BEGGING you please change the packaging. There is nothing wrong with a tube, no need to be trendy here. Just give me my moisturizer in a package that doesn’t break please.

This low review isn’t for the product itself but the packaging it came in . I am unsure if I received a defective unit or someone thought it was a good packaging idea , but the moisturizer will not come out no matter how hard you press down , if it’s upside down , if you take the top off , nothing , so this purchase was a COMPLETE waste of time 😒
I love this moisturizer but the packaging has made it impossible for me to actually use the product!!

avis.titre: Used and EMPTY product was sent.
avis.texte: Cannot write a review on the product because was unable to use. I was sent and emptied damaged clearly used bottle of moisturizer. Even the writing on the bottle had been worn off.

The very first time I used this at my sisters house I was totally hooked, we even just got each other boxes for Christmas lol but I’m giving four stars because as someone else stated, the letters and print on the bottle come off, and onto my hands with all the lotion onto my face. That’s ridiculous. I also had so many issues with the pump not working, it would totally be hit or miss if it wanted to work and there’s no way to just “take the lid off and shake some out” at all so that was extremely frustrating to have to use some old stuff I had on hand when it decided the pump didn’t want to work. But other than these issues, I love it, clearly i continue to buy but my annoyances are still annoying.

This is a very nice, hydrating facial moisturizer, and is great for anyone with dry skin or just those who need a little extra hydration in these colder months. With this, it is sulfate free, cruelty free, vegan and dermatology tested. I love the ingredients line up as well, which includes aloe vera, hyaluronic acid, squalene, shea butter and more. For the current sale price of $16.99 I would definitely order this again. However, I do believe that the “original” price of $42.99 is quite extreme for this small 1.7 fluid ounce bottle.

I have combination skin and don’t always like applying products on my face as they can make it feel greasy But with these Midwest winters sometimes you just need something to help moisturize your face Curology is a great brand that is backed by dermatologist This cream has a fun pump on it that gives you the right amount The cream is moisturizing but not greasy which I love. It’s also fragrance free which is perfect for sensitive skin

avis.titre: Such a luscious cream, leaves skin feeling like velvet
avis.texte: I love this cream, the cream feels so smooth and velvety, with no fragrance and it glides on the skin, feeling lightweight, but still providing an amazing moisturized feeling. The skin felt velvety smooth after application. Such an amazing feel and a great addition to the skin care routine, would highly recommend.
